en.title: Qualification Scoring System
en.excerpt: Operational guidance for qualifying scoring from session setup to leaderboard validation.
en.content:
Qualification Session

The committee can hold one or more qualifying sessions in one event. Each session can have a different configuration of the number of ends and the number of arrows per end.

Pad Placement

Assignment of participants to pads can be done manually or using Auto-Assign for more even distribution.

Input Score

Scores are input via mobile scoring or web dashboard. The value per arrow (including X/M if used) is automatically calculated into totals, hits, and tie-break indicators.

Validate Score

  • Make sure the number of arrows is filled according to the end configuration.
  • Verify there are no duplicate/missed marks before submitting.
  • Make corrections only by authorized personnel to ensure a consistent audit trail.

Leaderboard

Leaderboard updates automatically in real-time. The ranking order follows the total score rules, then the tie-break indicator according to the competition format.

id.title: Sistem Scoring Kualifikasi
id.excerpt: Panduan operasional scoring kualifikasi dari setup sesi hingga validasi leaderboard.
id.content:
Sesi Kualifikasi

Panitia dapat membuat satu atau lebih sesi kualifikasi dalam satu event. Tiap sesi dapat memiliki konfigurasi jumlah end dan jumlah anak panah per end yang berbeda.

Penempatan Bantalan

Penempatan peserta ke bantalan dapat dilakukan manual atau memakai Auto-Assign untuk distribusi yang lebih merata.

Input Skor

Skor diinput melalui mobile scoring atau dashboard web. Nilai per panah (termasuk X/M jika digunakan) dihitung otomatis menjadi total, hit, dan indikator tie-break.

Validasi Skor

  • Pastikan jumlah panah terisi sesuai konfigurasi end.
  • Verifikasi tidak ada nilai ganda/terlewat sebelum submit.
  • Lakukan koreksi hanya oleh petugas berwenang agar jejak audit tetap konsisten.

Leaderboard

Leaderboard diperbarui otomatis secara real-time. Urutan ranking mengikuti aturan skor total, lalu indikator tie-break sesuai format kompetisi.
